GTB Technologies



GTB Technologies


GTB Technologies  is an American company that offers innovative solutions in the field of Data Loss Prevention (DLP). Founded in 2004, GTB Technologies is one of the leaders in the cybersecurity industry with offices around the world. An important advantage of GTB Technologies is a powerful office in Ukraine, where a team of experienced Ukrainian developers works.

DECISION


Comprehensive data protection




GTB DLP Suite

FEATURES


Features of the DLP system from GTB Technologies

Any company that has valuable data sooner or later decides to implement a DLP system. Modern companies offer a large number of options. DLP programs are divided into three categories according to the method of finding leaks:

  • data-in-use — in the process of using information;
  • data-in-motion — during the transmission of information;
  • data-at-rest — during storage.

GTB DLP Suite recognizes   data in transit and at rest. Recognition works for MS Office documents, PDFs and regular images. Libraries are available in 75 languages. The company also offers a unique GTB Fingerprinting technology that protects huge databases with a minimum of hash fingerprints.

Unlike other companies’ products, GTB provides full visibility into data moving across cloud services. The products also have a feature to block unauthorized access to the cloud.

One of the company’s key solutions is  GTB Inspector . The product classifies data in real time and provides operational information about where users are moving information. Another GTB program – DLP for Intellectual Property protection – is aimed at protecting intellectual property. With its help, you can track all changes to documents and identify users who have access to them.

iIT Distribution  is an authorized distributor  of GTB Technologies , providing distribution and promotion of solutions in Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Poland, as well as professional support for their design and implementation.

VIDEO


GTB Technologies: A new approach to data loss prevention

The GTB DLP Suite system   is one of the company’s most important products. Thanks to its high modularity, the system effectively intercepts and analyzes all traffic transmitted over the network, monitors confidential data in traffic, establishes control over access to information on all devices, etc.

MANUFACTURERS


A reputation as a reliable partner who always fulfills its obligations!














































































































































































































































































































































Why do you need a DLP system?

Valuable data has always existed, and with it — methods of protecting it. With the advent of computer technology, data has become one of the main values ​​of corporations, the state and individuals. Data leakage is a serious problem for any bank, commercial company or government institution. The implementation of DLP security systems helps to prevent the loss of valuable information.

DLP most often stands for data loss prevention. The term has been widely used since 2006, but the first DLP systems existed even earlier. DLP technologies, on the one hand, developed as new data loss incidents appeared, and on the other hand, they were limited by legislation.

Many DLP products are not limited to preventing leaks directly. The systems also protect data from threats — both internal and external, keep track of working hours, control their actions on servers, including remotely. This has led to the fact that some DLP systems are aimed exclusively at monitoring the corporate environment, they lack the main function — blocking data transmission. Therefore, the term DLP is sometimes used in a broad sense.

Support for DLP solutions from iIT Distribution

IT Distribution is a team of experienced Ukrainian professionals. We represent on the Ukrainian market the products of GTB Technologies, American developers who were among the first to develop DLP systems. GTB Technologies offers functional solutions, original technologies and control of a large number of protocols. As official representatives of GTB Technologies in Ukraine, we implement and support DLP solutions for Ukrainian businesses.

The cost of a DLP system includes one-time costs when purchasing the product: expertise, development of a security policy, purchase of a license, implementation. The price of a DLP system depends on the configuration, but in general it is affordable enough to buy even for a small business.
